tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor chog bsdus pa shin tu nyams len bde ba bar chad kun bcom dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs so// na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ya/ kun dga'i mtshan can dges pa rdo rje dang / /bstan bsrung 'khor bcas zhabs la gus btud nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' srol ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma'i cho ga mdor bsdus rim pa bri/ /de la 'dir mchod gtor bsham pa ni/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris 'bur gang 'byor gyi mdun du/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa la zlum gtor gsum mam lnga sogs rgyu dang bstun pa'i mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang / rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams bshams te/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ rang yi dam mam mgon po gang rung gi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ rdo rje'i rtses nas nang mchod gtor ma la 'thor tshul bya zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gtor ma'i 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dang zla ba'i steng du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi lnga dang ye shes lnga'i sa bon/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dbus rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa steng du song bas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags/ yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim pas 'og tu lhung ste kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsis rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ

mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan la hūm̐ las kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ de'i pang na aṃ las rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i steng du/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ rnams las lha mo brgyad du gyur te thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag yar lud pa las so so'i rigs bdag gi dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra nī rī ti hūm̐ khaṃ nai wi d+ye hūm̐ khaṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghāṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can las 'od 'phros gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ pad skor bya zhing / oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñja/ dzi gha/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ piṅgha/ am+pa/ saspa/ kadz+dza/ sādha/ khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ ga da/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇa a d+ya nut+pan+na twata/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod mtheb srin g.yon gyis gtor zhing / kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo thugs kar bzung / g.yon dril bu gsum brdung du dkrol la/ dkar mo ri dwags nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs nas/ yid kyi dgyes zhes pa'i bar brjod/

rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu bcad btubs su dkrol la/ kye yi rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnom la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag phyag gnyis kyi dbus na gan+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ dar gyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klub pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su bya nag g.yon du khyi nag rgyab tu ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon ṭaṃ las e ka dza ti sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ de'i lto ba yangs par trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gi gang ba/ g.yon dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/

rlon pa'i do shal dang rus pa'i rgyan drug can/ glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ ba glang gi ko ba dang / re lde'i sham thabs can/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos gri gug g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gi gang ba/ g.yas gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pas ru phreng 'phyar thabs su 'dzin zhing / zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ sring mo bzhi'i bskor ba/ gzhan yang pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan la hūm̐ aṃ yaṃ maṃ tri tri bh+yoḥlas dur khrod bdag po yab yum sha za 'bum dang bcas pa/ las mkhan gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra lcam sring / 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi sogs pho nya bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bh+yoḥdang / hūm̐ las dkar bdud lcam dral/ phur bsrung bcu gnyis la sogs pa dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye ma hā kā li de wi ye/ tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wa ra/ sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya ti kra ma sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu zhes pa dam la bzhag par bsam/ oṃ shrī mā hā kā la ye ma hā kā li de wi ye/ tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta tha ga tu bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khāṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+ya di swāhā/ lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi phyi mchod/ bdud rtsi srin lag gis gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod phul/ dril bu sil zhing /

hūm̐ gang gi 'khrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /nye bar bsgrub nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs bsrung ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ las kyi mgon po/ dkar bdud phur bsrung sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing rgyas pa dang / phyi nang gi bar chad zhi zhing / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas te bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ ces bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ oṃ ā hūm̐ bhu mi pa ti a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇa a de nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis phul/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pas/ bdag cag dpon slob la rung rnga dang phrag dog ma mdzad par stong grogs mdzod/ de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ rten yod na oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ ces pas brtan par bsam/ lha brgyad kyi sku med na mdun gyi lha brgyad rang gi snying khar thim zhes dang / rten gzhan med pa rnams la dmigs te badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga nas/ /chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces brjod do/ /mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod mod kyang / /tshig mang skrag pas 'jigs rnams la/ /nyung bsdus go bde'i sa lo'i gsungs/ /ngag gi dbang pos sbyar ba dge/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin/ gtor chog bsdus pa shin tu nyams len bde ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
